column1: # The context checkpoint count each registry row serves with. server-context.cpp
# copies the recurrent state at checkpoint boundaries so a second turn sharing
# a long prefix restores the newest checkpoint below the divergence point rather
# than re-prefilling from zero; a hybrid Gated DeltaNet model rolls nothing back
# without one. The count is per row because the classes disagree on fidelity:
# evidence/ctx-checkpoint-sweep/ measures a 275x to 500x second-turn prefill
# reduction on every class. The 0.8B alone emitted a different first-turn token
# at zero-based index 25 whenever checkpoints were armed, which the forced
# prefill tail partition in server-context.cpp produced;
# patches/llama-server-natural-checkpoint-boundary.patch removes that partition
# and evidence/ctx-checkpoint-natural-boundary/ measures all three classes
# holding token and log-probability identity across the setting, so every
# served row reads 2. A row absent from this ledger serves at 0. A count above 0 names the evidence
# directory that measured it; `-` is admitted for 0 alone. qwen-capacity-policy.sh
# sets --ctx-checkpoints from the row on the single-model path, and in router
# mode every preset section carries LLAMA_ARG_CTX_CHECKPOINTS from the row,
# since common_preset::merge would push one router argv value onto every child.
